Kick and ban work on invite-code players, by the player's own account.

## Server

### Added
- RCON `kick <player|id>`. `players` lists each player with an id: the player's Epic account id for invite-code players. Kick and ban by that id when two players share a name; a name with spaces goes in quotes (`kick "Player 1"`).
- `AllowedReaders` in `appsettings.json`: the addresses allowed to reach the HTTP API at all. Empty (the default) means anyone; this machine is always allowed.

### Changed
- Bans and the roster key players by their account id, so two players with the same name stay apart.
- A kicked or banned player gets the game's return-to-menu message; a player still connected 3 seconds later loses their character and controller on the server.
- The supervisor runs on .NET 10.

Players need nothing installed: in Solarpunk's main menu choose Join session, type the server's 5-letter code and press Done.
